correctness.rationale: From MM^T=(k-2)I+2J and square invertibility, both point and block pairs have exactly two common opposite-sort elements. For three same-sort objects all eight possible incidence cells are computed explicitly and t is 0 or 1; all required nonzero cells remain nonempty at k>=5, with the minimum none-cell value one. Each pair extends to both t-values. For mixed triples, all four opposite-side membership counts remain positive after removing the named block (2, k-2, k-2, (k-2)(k-3)/2); the symmetric same-side extension counts likewise remain positive. This proves rank-one triple, rank-two pair, rank-three singleton and rank-four root invariance. Rank-four witness formulas separate k=3,4,>=5; k=5 exists. Independent exhaustive tuple-type programs verify examples for k=3,4,5,6. Finite checks supplement but do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The lambda=2 symmetric-design family has nontrivial isomorphism diversity and unknown global order existence, yet its exact bounded-depth first-order partition collapses to three sharp classes represented by only 4,7,11 points and blocks. The first quantifier rank distinguishing the transition from k=4 to larger biplanes is exactly four. This invariant and structural transfer from triple intersections to logical rank is mathematically motivated and is not an arbitrary finite slice.
